_comment: Shared vectors for the lift of a ContextMenu's source and the fold of
its panel back into it (CoreContextMenuLift, CoreContextMenuLiftTimeline,
CoreContextMenuRetract). The numbers of the look are CoreContextMenuStyle's
defaults and the numbers of the gesture are CoreContextMenuContract's.
Read by coui_core (every row on the functions and the timeline), coui_flutter
(the traces as real pointer events, key events and a controller on a real
ContextMenu, reading the widgets that were painted), coui_web (the traces
on the press tracker and the timeline with a manual clock, and the same
numbers on the markup) and the Chrome probe (the computed style of the real
page). A change on one platform fails the others.
Expected values were computed by an independent reference (the cubic-bezier
solved by bisection on x, not by the solver the Dart code uses) from the
arithmetic the contract documents.
All times are ms. 'progress' rows are the pure function; 'settle' rows are
its way back; 'visuals' are what a progress looks like; 'retract' rows give
the pivot, scale, opacity and the rect a panel occupies at fractions of its
close; 'traces' are what an opening does (events = what the person or the
page does, timeline = the calls the seat makes on the timeline, samples =
what is on screen at that time, measured from the first event).
Event kinds: down, move, up, cancel, scroll (web only), open (via
secondaryClick | key | controller), close (via escape | outside | controller).
'platforms' names who replays a trace (absent: both).
'riseDuration' rows are the rule that holds a held touch's rise to what the
hold leaves (requested in, run out). 'override' states a style with other
numbers, and the traces and the fold under it.

_comment: A style that states other numbers than the defaults: the same shape as
"numbers", the traces of the lift under them, and the fold under the
retractScale. Read by every seat that mounts a menu with
contextMenuStyle = CoreContextMenuStyle(liftScale, liftDuration,
liftDimOpacity, liftCast, liftRadius, retractScale) built from
"numbers" here - and, for the theme, the same style given to the
CoreContextMenuTheme. A trace names the "durationMs" the style states;
what the seat runs is the rise the hold leaves of it. Expected values
come from the same independent reference as the rest of this table.
The cast in "numbers" is one layer, different from the default in every
field, so a seat that reads a default anywhere shows it.

traces.name: a shorter rise, held to the end: the lift is there well before the hold
an over-long rise is held to what the hold leaves: it is whole when the menu opens
with no hold there is nothing to finish before: an over-long rise runs as stated
let go mid-rise: it comes back over the rise the style states
a style that states no rise lifts in a jump once the delay is over

riseDuration.name: the default fits in the hold
exactly what the hold leaves is kept
one millisecond more is held to what the hold leaves
a very long rise is held to what the hold leaves
no hold: the rise is as stated
no hold: a short rise is as stated
zero is a jump, with no hold
less than zero is a jump, held
less than zero is a jump, with no hold
a hold no longer than the delay leaves nothing
a hold shorter than the delay leaves nothing, never less than zero
